author: "McKayla Ford"
date: "2026-08-10"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
file_str <- "rosalind_dna.txt"
DNA_str <- readr::read_file(file_str)
```
Simplest version is to utilize stringr
```{r}
library(stringr)
```
```{r}
a_cnt <- str_count(DNA_str, "A")
g_cnt <- str_count(DNA_str, "G")
t_cnt <- str_count(DNA_str, "T")
c_cnt <- str_count(DNA_str, "C")
```

```{r}
cnt_char <- paste0(a_cnt, " ", c_cnt, " ", g_cnt, " ", t_cnt)
```

```{r}
cat(cnt_char, file = "output.txt")
```
